grammar.actionVerbs: makes, can use, uses, attacks, casts, has, also makes

autorecMenu.name: Multiattack Autorecognition Menu
autorecMenu.label: Configure Multiattacks
autorecMenu.hint: Open the central autorecognition menu to inspect, edit, or test recognized multiattack templates and monster overrides.

autorecExchangeMenu.name: Import / Export Multiattacks
autorecExchangeMenu.label: Import / Export JSON
autorecExchangeMenu.hint: Import or export central multiattack autorecognition configurations as JSON.

automatedSupportMenu.name: Automated Support (LLM) Configuration
automatedSupportMenu.label: Configure Automated Support
automatedSupportMenu.hint: Configure optional AI / LLM fallback parsing and sequence repair agent settings.

autoTriggerOnUse.name: Auto-Trigger on Multiattack Activity Use
autoTriggerOnUse.hint: Automatically initiate the multiattack sequence via dnd5e.postUseActivity when a Multiattack feature is used.

showChatCardButton.name: Show Chat Card Execute Button
showChatCardButton.hint: Inject an 'Execute Multiattack' button onto Multiattack chat cards for manual or repeat activation.

enableLlmFallback.name: Enable LLM Fallback for Unknown Templates
enableLlmFallback.hint: If enabled, unrecognized homebrew multiattack phrasings will be abstracted into <ITEM_N> placeholders and sent to the configured LLM, then cached centrally.

llmProvider.name: LLM Provider
llmProvider.hint: Select the LLM API provider for parsing novel multiattack phrasings.

llmApiKey.name: LLM API Key
llmApiKey.hint: API key for the selected LLM provider (stored locally or per world). Leave blank if using deterministic parsing or local Ollama without auth.

llmModel.name: LLM Model Name
llmModel.hint: Model identifier to request (e.g., gpt-4o-mini, gemini-2.5-flash, claude-3-5-haiku-latest).

llmEndpoint.name: Custom LLM Endpoint URL
llmEndpoint.hint: Optional custom endpoint URL for OpenAI-compatible servers (e.g., http://localhost:11434/v1/chat/completions).

autoSelectSingleOption.name: Auto-Execute Single Attack Options
autoSelectSingleOption.hint: Automatically roll the next attack without prompting when there is only one valid attack option remaining.

clearTargetsBetweenAttacks.name: Clear Targets Between Attacks
clearTargetsBetweenAttacks.hint: Clear user targets after each individual attack in the multiattack sequence.

logVerbosity.name: Log Verbosity
logVerbosity.hint: Control console logging detail level for debugging multiattack parsing and execution.

autorecMenu.title: Bakana's Multiattack Autorecognition Manager
autorecMenu.searchPlaceholder: Filter templates or monsters (e.g. two attacks, Dragon)...

selectDialog.title: Select Multiattack Option
selectDialog.subtitle: Step {step} of {totalSteps} — Choose next attack to execute:
